red_gridpoints.pro


Routines

top source red_gridpoints

CRISP pipeline

result = red_gridpoints(x0, y0, dx, dy, theta, Nx, Ny [, grid=struct or array])

Model grid point coordinates.

Return value

The coordinates of the grid points in a structure with the fields x and y.

Parameters

x0 in type=float or struct

Grid offset in X direction [pixels].

y0 in type=float

Grid offset in Y direction [pixels].

dx in type=float

Grid spacing in X direction [pixels].

dy in type=float

Grid spacing in Y direction [pixels].

theta in type=float

Grid rotation angle [radians].

Nx in type=integer

Number of grid points in the X direction.

Ny in type=integer

Number of grid points in the Y direction.

Keywords

grid in optional type=struct or array

If a struct, the members are the parameter values. Otherwise, the elements of the array are the parameter values. The parameters themselves are ignored if this keyword is used.
